proposed_edges.relationship: Examines railroad construction, finance, freight markets and recurrent bankruptcy as problems of economic history, connecting private returns with public subsidies (Railroaded, 2011)
proposed_edges.evidence_note: White’s own selected 2011 interview passages distinguish profits from construction and financing from the operation of railroads, and examine political favours and bankruptcy. This records an inquiry into economic organization and corporate capitalism, not founding a field, accepted agreement with other named historians or an influence inferred from bibliographies. The complete book is unread.
